about: Lab runs: whole SSCOFS runs kept for exploring (full volume, depth-averaged current, phase map, passes, patterns). Each <id>.json follows the same contract as sscofs/latest.json, its paths relative to lab/. pipeline/lab.py in salish-sea-flow-explorer.

sets.label: In between · 1–4 Oct 2026
sets.note: Between neaps and springs, towards springs — Seattle's range averages 12.1 ft over these 3 days (NOAA predictions for 9447130). The first lab run: SSCOFS 21Z 1 Oct 2026, 72 h.

sets.label: Neap tides · 18–21 Sep 2026
sets.note: Neap tides: the smallest of the two months NOAA keeps — Seattle's range averages 8.8 ft over these 3 days (NOAA predictions for 9447130). SSCOFS 03Z 18 Sep 2026, 72 h.

sets.label: Spring tides · 11–14 Aug 2026
sets.note: Spring tides: the largest of the two months NOAA keeps — Seattle's range averages 14.0 ft over these 3 days (NOAA predictions for 9447130). SSCOFS 03Z 11 Aug 2026, 72 h.
